verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a public API platform (cards, payments, transactions, expense data) with authentication (mTLS/OAuth2), specific endpoints, webhooks with HMAC verification, and SDKs (TypeScript/Python), which supports AI-native programmatic access. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec at the redocly root, and no independent corroboration of the API being usable/robust in practice. Missing for 10: public machine-readable OpenAPI spec discoverable via probe, independent/hands-on verification of API usage, and broader endpoint documentation beyond a few examples.
